mcqs.question: After Saudi Arabia joined the International Big Cat Alliance on 22 May 2026, what was the resulting composition of the alliance?
mcqs.explanation: Saudi Arabia’s entry on 22 May 2026 took the International Big Cat Alliance to 26 members and 5 observers. The tempting figures of 25 members and 6 observers do not reflect the post-entry composition.

mcqs.question: Which option correctly states the Union Cabinet approval and the Environment Minister associated with the International Big Cat Alliance?
mcqs.explanation: The International Big Cat Alliance received Union Cabinet approval in February 2024, and Bhupender Yadav was the Environment Minister. February 2026 is incorrect, while “Union Cabinet” is the approving body rather than the minister.
